# Decision record template

- ID and date:
- Status: ADOPTED / PROPOSED / OPEN / SUPERSEDED
- Owner/reviewer:
- Related requirement/question IDs:

## Problem and evidence

State the concrete trigger, available facts and the consequence of leaving it unresolved.

## Decision

State one precise policy, its scope and what remains unchanged. Identify whether it is an engineering choice or needs an owner preference.

## Alternatives and tradeoffs

List only meaningful alternatives, costs and failure cases. Explain why the smallest suitable approach was selected.

## Consequences and verification

Identify affected documents/interfaces, migrations, invalidation/backfill, tests and remaining limitations. Name any superseded decision; do not rewrite history silently.
